patterns.note: Content sections consistently use a two-column layout with a dark background, alternating between text-heavy and image-heavy content blocks.
The hero section features oversized, decorative serif typography with custom underlines for key action words, creating a strong visual statement.
The site primarily uses a high-contrast dark theme (black/very dark brown) for content sections, offset by a light off-white for the footer and a distinct muted pink accent color.
The main navigation bar transforms on scroll: it shrinks in height and gains a solid dark background, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
All major content blocks (cocktails, about, hours) are presented as full-width sections with a uniform dark background, creating a cohesive visual flow.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a full-bleed background image with large, custom-styled text elements that include decorative underlines. The text scrolls with the image, without parallax.

A sticky header effect is implemented where the navigation bar dynamically reduces its height and changes its background from transparent to a solid dark color once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections utilize a simple two-column grid within a dark container, allowing for flexible arrangement of text and imagery, often with a call-to-action button styled with an underlined text link.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative serif headings (~4-5x body) for the hero, with elegant serif headings (~2x body) for sections, and clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with all elements maintaining crisp, angular corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable padding within content blocks, especially in the hero.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a bold, decorative display font for the hero text, combined with custom underlines and a rich, dark interior photograph, immediately conveys an upscale and sophisticated brand identity. The specific muted pink accent color further enhances this unique, luxurious feel.
